stderr_matches: \[kuna --jobs\] structsynth: \d+ decompile\(s\) of the functions with synthesized structures again
stderr_absent: worker shards recovered different user-defined types

notes: A serial export of this fixture declares `struct struct_0 {`. Each worker used to number its own struct_N and the merged .h tore definitions apart; then workers ran with structsynth off. Now the functions that synthesize are decompiled again with the serial names by workers that all mint the same replayed structures first, so their .h type blocks agree and the merge warning never fires.
